tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant – Java, Spring, B2B E-Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM integrations. Proven track record in B2B e-commerce platforms, agile Scrum teams, and techno-functional consulting – gathering requirements, writing user stories, and guiding international stakeholders. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and AI-assisted development. Holds SAP Commerce Cloud certification and a German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am excited by CompuGroup Medical’s mission to digitise healthcare across Europe. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep B2B e-commerce expertise and a proven ability to translate business goals into robust technical solutions.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and delivered SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, leading backend development, data-modeling and API extensions for B2B product catalogs.

bullets.label: Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Built end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring synchronized product data across global channels.

bullets.label: Agile Product Delivery
bullets.text: Worked in Scrum teams, wrote user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specs, and coordinated international stakeholders to prioritize features.

bullets.label: API & Platform Modernisation
bullets.text: Migrated legacy customer-account APIs to OCC REST services, improving stability and supporting headless commerce integrations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German residence and work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 with earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work and looks forward to discussing how I can contribute.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von CompuGroup Medical, die digitale Gesundheitsversorgung in Europa zu stärken, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in SAP Commerce Cloud für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte B2B-E-Commerce-Erfahrung und die Fähigkeit, Geschäftsziele in stabile technische Lösungen zu überführen.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Lösungen konzipiert und umgesetzt, die Backend-Entwicklung, Datenmodellierung und API-Erweiterungen für B2B-Produktkataloge umfassen.

bullets.label: Integrations-Leadership
bullets.text: Ich habe End-to-End-PIM-ERP-MDM-Pipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders aufgebaut und damit die Synchronisation von Produktdaten über globale Kanäle sichergestellt.

bullets.label: Agile Produktlieferung
bullets.text: In Scrum-Teams erstellte ich User-Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und Funktionsspezifikationen und koordinierte internationale Stakeholder zur Priorisierung von Features.

bullets.label: API- und Plattform-Modernisierung
bullets.text: Ich migrierte Legacy-Kunden-Account-APIs zu OCC-REST-Services, steigerte die Systemstabilität und unterstützte Headless-Commerce-Integrationen.

cover_de.logistics: Wohnhaft in Karlsruhe, gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026. Flexibel für Remote, Hybrid oder Vor-Ort-Einsatz und freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: CompuGroup Medical stands at the intersection of healthcare and technology, shaping patient-centric solutions that improve outcomes across 19 countries. Your commitment to innovative, secure e-commerce platforms for medical services aligns perfectly with my experience delivering robust SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global B2B customers. I am eager to contribute my integration expertise and agile product mindset to help you expand and modernise your digital health commerce ecosystem.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join CompuGroup Medical to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and B2B e-commerce expertise to a purpose-driven company that is transforming digital health services across Europe.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years in B2B e-commerce. I’m keen to discuss the Product Owner role at CompuGroup Medical and how my integration and agile experience can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner – SAP Commerce Cloud position at CompuGroup Medical. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud development and techno-functional consulting for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your digital health commerce strategy.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.
